latest.title: Amazon ECS Managed Instances Now Supports NVIDIA GPU Metrics
latest.description: GPU monitoring on ECS Managed Instances no longer requires a custom stack. This post breaks down the 14 NVIDIA GPU metrics now available through Container Insights with enhanced observability, along with setup steps and cost considerations.

latest.title: The Difference Between “Knowing AWS” and “Being Able to Build on AWS”
latest.description: I thought learning AWS meant understanding services and concepts—until I tried deploying real projects on my own. This article is about the gap between theoretical cloud knowledge and the practical skills that actually matter in projects, internships, and placements.

latest.title: Como passei na seletiva do programa de líderes estudantis builder AWS
latest.description:
Entrar para o Programa de Líderes Estudantis Builder AWS não depende apenas de saber tecnologia. O que realmente faz diferença é a forma como você comunica sua visão, sua autenticidade e o impacto que deseja gerar na comunidade.

Muita gente entra na seletiva pensando que precisa parecer “perfeito”, decorar frases robóticas ou falar como um profissional extremamente técnico. Mas a verdade é que a banca quer enxergar presença, clareza, liderança, comunicação e propósito.

latest.title: O AWS Builder Center como Catalisador de Carreiras em Cloud Computing
latest.description: Este artigo discute o impacto estratégico de vivenciar ferramentas de escala global ainda durante a formação. O texto aborda como a autonomia e o networking dentro de comunidades técnicas aceleram a prontidão profissional, transformando o aprendizado de infraestrutura escalável e inteligência artificial em uma vantagem competitiva real para o início da carreira.

latest.title: GPU Health Monitoring and Auto Repair for Amazon ECS Managed Instances
latest.description: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now handles GPU failure detection and instance replacement at the platform level, eliminating the custom monitoring stacks teams have long had to build and maintain. This post covers how the auto repair workflow operates, how to check GPU health and set up notifications, and when to keep auto repair on versus off depending on your workload.

latest.title: A Weekend at Karukinka — Troubleshooting a 9.6 kWh Solar System with an AI Coding Partner
latest.description: My inverter got stuck on grid after a single evening alarm. The pack kept tripping whenever the water pump turned on. I had one weekend on-site to make progress before driving back to Santiago. Here's how I used Kiro to turn two days of observations into durable, structured knowledge I can keep working on all week — including the two times I was wrong.

latest.title: I ran AWS Security Agent's full pipeline on my personal project: Design Review, Code Review, and Pentest
latest.description: Security doesn't end at launch — but ongoing validation rarely happens after a product ships. This article walks through running AWS Security Agent's full pipeline — Design Review, Code Review, and Penetration Test — on a real serverless app. Each stage catches different things: architecture gaps, PR-level issues, and a Critical hardcoded-credentials finding the others missed. Also covers cost planning, multi-account setup, and the role of human review alongside AI-driven security.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.
